title: Cardinality of a Sylow subgroup of a finite group
statement: Let $H$ be a finite group [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set] (a finite set with associative multiplication, identity $1$, and inverses), and let $p$ be a prime natural number. Let $P\subseteq H$ be a subgroup, meaning a subset containing $1$ and closed under multiplication and inverse. Suppose every $x\in P$ satisfies $x^{p^a}=1$ for some integer $a\geq0$, and $P$ is maximal among subgroups with this property. If $e$ is the largest integer $a\geq0$ for which $p^a$ divides $|H|$, then $|P|=p^e$.
